newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: CITY DEV UNIT IN PROJECT MANAGEMENT DEAL.
newsitem.headline: CITY DEV UNIT IN PROJECT MANAGEMENT DEAL.

text.p: City Developments Ltd (CDL) said on Friday a unit of the company entered into a project management contract with Mandai Properties Pte Ltd.
Its subsidiary City Project Management Pte Ltd (CPM) was appointed project manager to oversee the development of a warehouse complex in northern Singapore, CDL said in a statement.
CPM will be paid a fee of 1.75 percent of the total final construction costs of the project, estimated at S$50 million.
Mandai Properties, a joint venture company owned by Hong Realty Pte Ltd, Garden Estates and Mitsui & Co Ltd, is the owner of the properties.
CDL said the fee was within the range of fees charged by the CDL group for performing project management services.
